review_summary:
**Triage Summary:**

Five findings involve unpatched CRITICAL vulnerabilities in system libraries (zlib, OpenEXR, libaom) with extremely low exploit probability (EPSS ≤0.029) and no known active exploitation—these are likely theoretical or require impractical attack conditions. One HIGH-severity finding in picomatch has an available fix and minimal exploit likelihood (EPSS 0.004). 

**Recommended Action:** Approve the build with a tracking ticket to upgrade zlib, OpenEXR, and libaom when patches become available; immediately update picomatch to the fixed version since remediation is available and carries negligible risk.
